Editor.problem: Earlier point 2 is only partly fixed, so the title's "Two OTel Java Agent Changes" can still pass without proof. The plan now adds db_duration_max_dimensions (le 36), probe_largest_held, and untrimmed, trimmed and collector-added attribute counts. But fix.sh's `fixed` gate only checks `untrimmed > trimmed`. That can hardly fail: turning off two resource providers always removes attributes. Nothing measures whether a db.client.operation.duration series without the trim would go over 36 dimensions. That depends on everything a series carries: resource attributes, the metric's own attributes (db.system.name, db.namespace, db.operation.name, db.collection.name, db.query.summary, server.address, server.port, le), and what the Collector adds (cloud, host and k8s.*). The earlier fix also asked for a fallback: if the untrimmed count stays within 36, the title changes. That fallback appears nowhere in the plan. So a run can emit `fixed` while the trim is never shown to matter. The "8 cloud and host" and "6 process" attribute counts in the step 5 comment and the README also still come from the brief, not from the lab.
